cmd.banner: Type "help" to see the available commands.

help.intro: For more information on a specific command, type HELP command-name
help.call: Runs a batch file or a command from another batch file.
help.find: Searches for a text string in files or in piped output.
help.findstr: Searches for strings in files or in piped output.
help.if: Runs a command only when a condition is true.
help.more: Displays a file or piped output.
help.path: Displays the search path for executable files.
help.pause: Suspends processing of a batch file and displays a message.
help.sort: Sorts the lines of a file or piped output.
help.vol: Displays the disk volume label and serial number.
help.unknown: This command is not supported by the help utility.
help.cd: Displays the name of or changes the current directory.
help.color: Sets the console foreground and background colors.
help.copy: Copies one or more files to another location.
help.dir: Displays a list of files and subdirectories in a directory.
help.hostname: Prints the name of this device.
help.ipconfig: Displays the state of the network connection.
help.move: Moves files or directories, or renames them.
help.ren: Renames a file or a directory.
help.set: Displays, sets, or removes environment variables.
help.shutdown: Shuts down, restarts or signs out of the system.
help.start: Opens an app, a file or a folder in a new window.
help.systeminfo: Displays information about this device and system.
help.taskkill: Closes a window by its process ID or its image name.
help.tasklist: Displays the windows that are currently open.
help.title: Sets the window title of this Command Prompt.
help.tree: Graphically displays the folder structure of a path.
help.type: Displays the contents of a text file.
help.whoami: Displays the current device and user name.

errors.notRecognized:
'{name}' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
operable program or batch file.
errors.pathNotFound: The system cannot find the path specified.
errors.fileNotFound: The system cannot find the file specified.
errors.startNotFound: The system cannot find the file {name}.
errors.syntax: The syntax of the command is incorrect.
errors.exists: A subdirectory or file {name} already exists.
errors.duplicateName: A duplicate file name exists, or the file cannot be found.
errors.diskFull: There is not enough space on the disk.
errors.driveNotFound: The system cannot find the drive specified.
errors.copyOntoItself: The file cannot be copied onto itself.
errors.sameColors: The foreground and background colors cannot be the same.
errors.pipes: Pipes ( | ) are not supported in this console.
errors.batchDepth: Batch files are nested too deeply.
errors.batchLoop: The batch file ran for too long and was stopped.
errors.label: The system cannot find the batch label specified - {name}
errors.standalone: This command is only available inside the desktop.

dir.volume: Volume in drive C has no label.

taskkill.success: SUCCESS: The process with PID {pid} has been terminated.

shutdown.usage:
Usage: SHUTDOWN [/S | /R | /L | /H]

    /S    Shut down the system.
    /R    Restart the system.
    /L    Sign out.
    /H    Put the system to sleep.
